signature.name: Winchester Mystery House
signature.detail: A sprawling Victorian mansion famous for its maze-like layout, staircases to nowhere and doors that open onto walls. It is San Jose's most distinctive attraction and a must for first-time visitors. Book tickets online in advance and go early in the day to avoid the biggest crowds.

signature.name: Tech Interactive
signature.detail: An interactive science and technology museum in downtown San Jose with hands-on exhibits that suit both kids and adults. It is a good rainy-day or family stop. Check opening days before you go, as hours vary by season.

signature.name: Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum
signature.detail: Houses one of the larger collections of Egyptian artifacts on the US West Coast, set in a distinctive Egyptian-style building. It is a quieter, focused museum that rewards a couple of hours. Allow extra time to walk the surrounding park.

signature.name: San Jose Municipal Rose Garden
signature.detail: A free, well-kept rose garden that is especially pretty in spring and early summer when the blooms peak. It is an easy, relaxing stop. Visit in the morning for softer light and fewer people.

signature.name: Plaza de Cesar Chavez
signature.detail: The central downtown square, close to museums and the Tech Interactive, and a natural starting point for a walking day. It often hosts events. Combine it with nearby downtown sights rather than making a special trip.

signature.name: San Pedro Square Market
signature.detail: A lively downtown market hall with many food stalls and a sociable atmosphere, good for a casual meal. It is a practical lunch or dinner stop near the other downtown sights. Go slightly off peak hours to find seating.

signature.name: History Park
signature.detail: An outdoor history park with historic buildings and exhibits that give a sense of the region's past. It is a pleasant, low-key stop, especially for families. Check the schedule, as some buildings open only at certain times.

signature.name: San Jose Museum of Art
signature.detail: A downtown art museum with a focus on modern and contemporary work. It pairs well with the Tech Interactive and the plaza for a compact downtown day. Confirm current exhibitions and hours before visiting.
